Budget Itinerary from Pinus Pengger

A budget itinerary stresses shared transport and bringing your own supplies. This page gives an example without unconfirmed ticket figures.

Detail

How to lower cost

Use a private or shared vehicle for transport. Bring water and snacks from the city to reduce on-site spending.

Detail

Budget lines

  • Transport: fuel or shared rental.
  • Food & drink: bring some yourself.
  • Ticket/parking: ask at the gate, separate line.

Detail

Buffer

Carry small cash and an emergency line. Do not assume cards are accepted at small gates.

The exact budget is only known after ticket/parking prices are confirmed at the gate.

Frequently asked questions

Can Pinus Pengger be cheap?

Yes, with a shared vehicle and bringing your own water/snacks.

What is the exact cost?

Cannot be fixed yet because ticket/parking are unverified. Build from transport and food, then a separate ticket line.

Are cards accepted?

Unverified; carry cash in the hill area.

Is entry free?

Status is uncertain; ask staff at the gate.
